constraints: If file is a simple name (no pathname), the file must be located next to the database structure file.
The pasteboard cannot be modified (read-only) during the On Drag Over form event.
If non-pathname data was already in the pasteboard, it is erased regardless of whether '*' is passed.

overloadMerges.note: Clarifies the trailing '*' as a literal add-vs-replace mode discriminator.

params.description: If omitted, the pasteboard's contents are replaced by file's pathname. If passed, file's pathname is added to the pasteboard's existing stack of pathnames.
